_README: Term list for check_mannerisms.py. Extend the lists below as new tics are spotted. 'banned' = never acceptable in Stephen's writing. 'watch' = usually a tic but sometimes legitimate, so reported separately and does not fail the check on its own. 'allow_phrases' = exact strings that are genuine domain terminology and must never be flagged, even though they contain a banned/watch word.
_provenance: Seeded from humanizer/SKILL.md plus the tics Stephen flagged in 20260901-monthly-report-v1.6 on 4 Sep 2026 (pivotal x5, 'Stated once:', 'lands' used figuratively, cadence, posture).

banned.why: significance inflation; say what actually changed
de-duplication scaffolding leaking into prose; delete the label
scaffolding; cross-reference properly or repeat the fact
forced parallelism when paired with 'but also'

watch.why: figurative 'lands on/with' is a tic; literal 'the quote lands' is fine
usually filler, but real in grant terminology
vague; say what was actually said or done

_em_dash_note: Stephen's CLAUDE.md forbids em dashes in all writing for him. Always checked.
